semantic_boundary.retained_concept: Annual Ministry government-debt principal repayments/refinancing component.

scientific_interpretation: The prior blocker was a seven-observation low-frequency history with mixed FINAL and OPERATIVE statuses and no preregistered revision/sufficiency rule.

The frozen promotion contract now supplies a source-precedence and revision rule before canonical materialization/promotion, and the materialized history contains twelve consecutive completed annual observations from 2013 through 2024.
All retained values are official Ministry observations or retrospective/year-end execution values; no forecast, plan or estimate is present in the canonical series.

The annual history is sufficient as a behaviour-over-time reference target. This does not identify the government repricing share m[t] and does not validate the refinancing/effective-rate behavioural mechanism.
